summary.result: As expected, surface applied beds demonstrated two to three magnitudes order greater in both the study microorganisms as compared to soil incorporated beds.
summary.background: The objective of this study was to compare fecal microbes survival in soil between compost surface application and soil incorporation.
summary.method: The survival experiment was conducted in six styrofoam beds ( $510{\times}325{\times}305(mm)$ in size) filled with sandy loam soil.
